variants.omim_name: ADGB, VARIANTS IN THE ANDROGLOBIN (ADGB) GENE

records.label: Infertile male with asthenozoospermia
quotes: Variants in the androglobin (ADGB) gene were identified in an infertile male characterized by asthenozoospermia.

records.label: Patient with homozygous ADGB frameshift
quotes: We found one homozygous frameshift ADGB variant (NM_024694.4: c.2801_2802del:p.K934Rfs*33)
the spermatozoa from patients harboring ADGB variants showed multiple acrosome and flagellum malformations under light and electron microscopy

records.label: Patient with homozygous ADGB p.T1056I
quotes: one homozygous missense ADGB variant (NM_024694.4: c.C3167T:p.T1056I)
the spermatozoa from patients harboring ADGB variants showed multiple acrosome and flagellum malformations under light and electron microscopy

records.label: Patient with compound heterozygous ADGB p.T1056I/p.A1066V
quotes: one compound heterozygous ADGB variant (NM_024694.4: c.C3167T:p.T1056I; c.C3197T:p.A1066V)
the spermatozoa from patients harboring ADGB variants showed multiple acrosome and flagellum malformations under light and electron microscopy

records.label: OAT patient with ADGB compound heterozygous mutations

phenotypes.text: sperm tail defects (short, angled, coiled, absent tails)

quotes: 该患者精液分析提示严重特发性少弱畸精子症（oligoasthenoteratozoospermia, OAT）（浓度：2.0×106 mL－1，前向运动精子比：<1%，正常形态精子比例：0）（表1），生殖内分泌指标正常，染色体核型为46，XY，无Y染色体微缺失。
通过Sanger测序确定该患者为ADGB复合杂合突变（NM_024694.4: c.4859G>A, p.Arg1620Gln; c.4981A>G, p.Lys1661Glu）（图1A）。
TEM observations showed spermatozoa with acrosome loss, disorganized mitochondrial sheath helical structures, and disrupted or partially absent "9 + 2" microtubule structures in the axoneme.

notes.statement: Wang et al. (2026) performed whole-exome sequencing in 781 Chinese men with primary infertility and found 148 ADGB variants. Of these, 6 were classified as likely pathogenic, and 2 of the 6 were present in a single patient with oligoasthenoteratozoospermia.
quotes: Among 781 infertile men, 148 ADGB gene mutation sites were identified. According to the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG) Variant Classification Guidelines, 45 sites were classified as benign mutations, one site as a potentially benign mutation, 96 sites as variants of uncertain significance, and 6 sites as potentially pathogenic mutations.

notes.statement: Wang et al. (2026) found that ADGB protein was absent from the patient's sperm on Western blot. On immunofluorescence, both ADGB and the acrosome marker PNA were reduced. In normal sperm, ADGB was enriched in the acrosome and the flagellar mitochondrial sheath.
quotes: Western blot analysis revealed absent ADGB protein expression in the patient's sperm.
通过免疫荧光分析，发现ADGB在正常精子中富集于顶体（PNA共定位）及鞭毛线粒体鞘（α-Tubulin共定位），而该患者的精子中PNA和ADGB表达均明显降低（图2B）。

notes.statement: Wang et al. (2026) found that ADGB expression in the human testis was low before puberty and increased after puberty. ADGB was enriched in spermatocytes and spermatids and localized to the acrosome and flagella. In mice, Adgb mRNA was highly expressed specifically in the testis and peaked at sexual maturity (postnatal day 40).
quotes: Additionally, ADGB was found to be highly expressed after puberty in both human and mouse testes and was localized to the acrosome and flagella of spermatogenic cells.
时序分析表明，小鼠睾丸中的Adgb mRNA水平在性成熟时（出生后40 d）升至最高，比青春期前明显增高（图5B）。

notes.statement: Wang et al. (2026) used co-immunoprecipitation to show that ADGB interacts with TTC29 and CFAP47 in sperm. Both TTC29 and CFAP47 were reduced in the patient's sperm. The authors suggested that ADGB may help maintain acrosome function and normal axoneme assembly through these interactions.
quotes: Co-immunoprecipitation experiments confirmed TTC29 and CFAP47 as interacting proteins of ADGB.
这些发现提示ADGB可能通过结合TTC29和CFAP47，从而维持顶体的功能和鞭毛轴丝的正常组装。

notes.statement: Wang et al. (2026) reported that the patient's partner achieved a successful pregnancy and full-term delivery after intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI). The authors noted that all 5 reported infertile couples with ADGB mutations had achieved clinical pregnancy with ICSI.
quotes: The patient carrying the pathogenic ADGB mutation achieved a successful pregnancy through intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) treatment.
目前报道的5例ADGB基因突变不孕夫妇均通过ICSI技术实现临床妊娠

notes.statement: Gao et al. (2025) performed whole-exome sequencing in 105 Han Chinese men with idiopathic asthenoteratozoospermia. They identified bi-allelic ADGB variants in 3 infertile men from unrelated families. The variants were rare in the general population and were predicted to be damaging by multiple bioinformatics tools.
quotes: in a cohort of 105 Han Chinese men with idiopathic asthenoteratozoospermia, we reported the identification of bi-allelic deleterious variants of ADGB in three infertile men from unrelated families using whole-exome sequencing
These variants were rare in general population and were predicted to be damaging by multiple bioinformatics tools.

notes.statement: Gao et al. (2025) found that the structural defects in patient sperm were associated with dysregulation of ADGB and multiple spermatogenesis proteins. Patient spermatozoa showed normal PLC-zeta expression but were deficient in calmodulin (CaM).
quotes: Functional assays revealed the structural defects associated with dysregulation of ADGB and multiple spermatogenesis proteins.
the normal expression of PLCζ but CaM deficiency in the spermatozoa

notes.statement: Gao et al. (2025) reported successful fertilization by ICSI in all 3 ADGB-deficient patients. They suggested that ICSI, rather than in vitro fertilization, is the optimal treatment for these patients, and highlighted an underlying risk of IVF failure.
quotes: Notably, the fertilization success via ICSI treatment in all three patients
suggesting that ICSI other than in vitro fertilization (IVF) is an optimal treatment for ADGB-deficient patients
The underlying risk of IVF failure behind sperm defects was highlighted.

notes.statement: Qu et al. (2023) found that the ADGB variants identified in an infertile man with asthenozoospermia disrupted the binding of ADGB to calmodulin.
quotes: The variants disrupted the binding of ADGB to calmodulin.

notes.statement: Qu et al. (2023) found that male Adgb -/- mice were infertile because of reduced sperm concentration (less than 1 x 10(6)/mL) and reduced sperm motility. Spermatogenesis was abnormal, with malformed elongating and elongated spermatids. The cauda epididymis had about twice as many apoptotic cells. Intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) with testicular spermatids allowed fertilization and development to the blastocyst stage.
quotes: Adgb-/- male mice were infertile due to reduced sperm concentration (< 1 × 106 /mL) and motility.
Spermatogenesis was also abnormal, with malformation of both elongating and elongated spermatids, and there was an approximately twofold increase in apoptotic cells in the cauda epididymis.
It is surprising that ICSI with testicular spermatids allows fertilization and eventually develops into blastocyst.

notes.statement: Using mass spectrometry, Qu et al. (2023) identified 42 candidate proteins that interact with ADGB and are involved in sperm assembly, flagella formation, and sperm motility. They confirmed that CFAP69 and SPEF2 bind to ADGB.
quotes: Through mass spectrometry, we identified 42 candidate proteins that are involved in sperm assembly, flagella formation, and sperm motility interacting with ADGB. In particular, CFAP69 and SPEF2 were confirmed to bind to ADGB.
